## Public idea

Arctura is a network where people and software contribute useful work, check results, keep a record, and improve the system they share.

Doctrine: Do the work. Check the work. Improve the system.

The agent guide is an Arctura operating note about defining work, selecting a capable model, choosing where it runs, improving it in measured stages, and keeping an evaluation record. It is not a vendor ranking.

The Agent Work Order builder is a local-only browser tool. It creates a portable JSON record for an agent's expected result, approved inputs, authority, acceptance checks, and evidence. It does not upload or retain user input.

The monthly Work / Proof / Stewardship record publishes observed adoption signals, unknowns, shipped artifacts, and next commitments. The August 2026 baseline reports GitHub repository traffic only and does not claim website visitors, customers, revenue, or active operators.

## Current operational boundary

Arctura Base is a real, documented **local Bittensor testnet subnet launch on netuid 505**. The primary implementation repository’s run plan documents Bittensor test-network commands using `--netuid 505`, plus bounded results: a miner reached live state and a validator entered its live loop and issued a mandate.

The public record does not convert that local-testnet launch into stronger unrecorded outcomes. The same run plan says that the miner was not running concurrently during the bounded validator run, so no miner response was observed, and short-run weight setting may not have been attempted. No external testnet metagraph or explorer snapshot is currently published.

Arctura is not currently represented as a live Bittensor Finney subnet. No mainnet netuid, emissions state, or live quorum state is published.

## Primary sources

- Local testnet launch and bounded run record: https://github.com/bittensaur/arctura-base-subnet/blob/main/docs/TESTNET_RUN_PLAN.md

- Published implementation, tests, and runbooks: https://github.com/bittensaur/arctura-base-subnet

## Related surfaces and source precedence

1. Arctura Network (`https://arctura.network/`) is authoritative for current network status and dated evidence records.
2. The Arctura base subnet repository (`https://github.com/bittensaur/arctura-base-subnet`) is authoritative for published code, tests, operations records, releases, issues, and runbooks.
3. Autonomous Resource Management (`https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/`) is the technical framework and standards reference; it is not direct proof of a particular Arctura Network run.
4. Arctura Observatory (`https://arctura.org/`) is the collective identity and contextual archive; it is not authoritative for current subnet state.

These are related properties with distinct roles, not alternate identities.

## Operational delegation

ARM Agency is Arctura Network's delegated DevOps provider for website delivery, deployment automation, DNS and edge operations, availability, and infrastructure security. The operational contact is ops@arm-agency.com. ARM Agency operates infrastructure under Arctura Network direction and is not authoritative for network, governance, token, treasury, or mainnet claims.

Both projects are currently bootstrapped. No current payment rail, currency, fee schedule, token obligation, or amount payable is published. Future compensation may use a separately approved mechanism such as x402 or a future network currency, but neither is a current commitment.
